name: cross-arch-cli-next-binaries-contract

scope.productSuccess: cross-ISA target-native semantic continuation from captured live state, or refusal

globalRule.productSuccess: cross-ISA target-native semantic continuation from captured live state, or refusal

ladderPriority.supportedSubset: regular-file reader continuation with modeled stdout cursor
ladderPriority.summary: Continue from captured input identity, read offset, partial buffer, and stdout cursor.

ladderPriority.supportedSubset: narrow regular-file copy continuation without unsafe device or conversion modes
ladderPriority.summary: Continue from captured input/output identities, block size, offsets, partial block, and counters.
Continue from captured byte offset, line count so far, partial newline state, and stdout cursor.

ladderPriority.supportedSubset: integer sequence continuation with modeled format and output cursor
ladderPriority.summary: Continue from captured current value, next value, end, step, format, and emitted item cursor.

ladderPriority.supportedSubset: fixed-string line matching over regular-file input
ladderPriority.summary: Continue from captured input cursor, partial line, matcher state, match count, selected flags, and output cursor.

cat.supportedSubset: single regular-file input or modeled stdin regular file with modeled stdout cursor and no terminal/session state
capturedSemanticState: executable identity for cat on source base
sourceArch and targetArch with cross-ISA proof
device and inode or stable identity digest
file size and mtime at capture
content hash window around read offset
no target process before eligibility evidence
targetContinuationStep: verify target architecture differs from source architecture
verify equivalent input file identity and content hash window
open target-native reader vessel without argv restart
seek to captured read offset
install partial buffer and stdout cursor
emit only bytes after the captured cursor
refuseWhen: terminal input or output is present
PTY or session state is present
pipe input or output is unmodeled
socket input or output is present
multiple input files are present before a list cursor is modeled
dirty writable fd alias is present
partial buffer is missing at a split read boundary
target execve from argv is attempted
proofMustShow: target emits first byte after captured read offset
target does not replay bytes before captured read offset
fresh argv restart would emit byte zero but continuation does not
refusal leaves no successful target process

dd.supportedSubset: regular-file input to regular-file output with simple block copy and no unsafe flags
capturedSemanticState: executable identity for dd on source base
sourceArch and targetArch with cross-ISA proof
targetContinuationStep: verify target architecture differs from source architecture
verify equivalent input and output file identities
open target-native copy vessel without argv restart
seek input and output to captured offsets
install partial block state and counters
copy only remaining blocks from captured state
refuseWhen: input or output is a device, tape, terminal, pipe, or socket
target execve from argv is attempted
proofMustShow: target copies from captured input offset to captured output offset
target does not recopy prior blocks
counters continue from captured values
refusal leaves no successful target process

wcLine.supportedSubset: line count for one regular-file input with modeled newline boundary and stdout cursor
capturedSemanticState: executable identity for wc on source base
sourceArch and targetArch with cross-ISA proof
targetContinuationStep: verify target architecture differs from source architecture
verify equivalent input file identity
open target-native wc-line vessel without argv restart
seek to captured byte offset
install line count and newline boundary state
count only remaining bytes and combine with captured count
refuseWhen: multiple inputs are present before list cursor is modeled
unmodeled locale or encoding is present
terminal, pipe, or socket state is present
target execve from argv is attempted
proofMustShow: target final line count includes captured line count plus remaining suffix count
target does not reread bytes before captured offset
fresh argv restart would count from byte zero but continuation does not
refusal leaves no successful target process

seq.supportedSubset: integer sequence with modeled step, end, format, emitted item cursor, and stdout cursor
capturedSemanticState: executable identity for seq on source base
sourceArch and targetArch with cross-ISA proof
targetContinuationStep: verify target architecture differs from source architecture
open target-native generator vessel without argv restart
install next value, end, step, format, separator, and output cursor
emit next captured value and following values only
refuseWhen: precision would differ across target ISA
partial formatted value state is missing
target execve from argv is attempted
proofMustShow: target emits captured next value first
target does not restart at first value
fresh argv restart would emit first value but continuation does not
refusal leaves no successful target process

fixedStringGrep.supportedSubset: fixed-string line matching for one regular-file input with modeled selected flags
capturedSemanticState: executable identity for grep on source base
sourceArch and targetArch with cross-ISA proof
targetContinuationStep: verify target architecture differs from source architecture
verify equivalent input file identity
open target-native fixed-string matcher vessel without argv restart
seek to captured byte offset
install partial line, matcher state, match count, and output cursor
match only lines after the captured cursor
refuseWhen: backrefs or locale-sensitive classes are present
multiple files are present before list cursor is modeled
target execve from argv is attempted
proofMustShow: target matches first eligible line after captured cursor
target does not rematch prior lines
target does not replay prior matched output
fresh argv restart would revisit earlier lines but continuation does not
refusal leaves no successful target process

globalRefusals: broad grep modes outside fixed-string subset
broad wc modes outside wc -l subset
unsafe dd device or conversion modes
sockets without explicit protocol state model
PTY or terminal state without explicit PTY/session model
shells without interactive session and job-control model
nonClaims: no pipe/socket/terminal/session movement without explicit models
